$description: Wrike public marketing tokens, measured 2026-11-18 from www.wrike.com (light theme, 1440x900 and 390x844) and login.wrike.com/login/ (signed out, nothing typed). Every colour is a computed style or a resolved custom property. No dark theme was painted on any signed-out marketing page.

brand.$value: TT_Norms_Pro, -apple-system, system-ui, Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

Measured: computed font-family on body, the email input and the Next button at https://login.wrike.com/login/.

Measured: .pricing-card__title computed 24px / 28.8px / 600. Token scale --website-heading-4-font-size--tablet is 24px and --website-heading-4-line-height is 1.2.
Measured: --website-paragraph-font-size 16px and --website-paragraph-line-height 1.6 on .website-theme. Body copy on the home hero uses the same size.
Measured: .website-btn.size--small computed font-size 16px, font-weight 600, line-height 20px.
Measured: .website-btn.size--large computed font-size 20px, font-weight 600, line-height 28px, height 60px.
